source_proposal_review.basis: Previously completed independent published-source and exact-note review; not a newly repeated manuscript collation.

approved_scope: Replace existing marker-a note with exactly the prior independently reviewed speech-variant disclosure.
Synchronize only connected lexical invitation alternatives/provenance/rationale and theological invitation descriptions.
Archive complete parsed old status, revision_pass and cross_check values under their actual baseline hash without inventing old review input bindings.
Clear inherited current approval-looking flags and add the narrow application-scope declaration.
rationale: The exact note preserves the published partial 4Q2 junction and distinguishes Samaritan/Greek, Latin and Syriac wording. Connected metadata now says the same thing and retains both loss and completion explanations. The main English including said to and its existing appropriate anchor, the whole source YAML component, unrelated lexical decisions and historical revisions are unchanged. Historical status and scores are preserved without being reused as new certification. No fresh HALOT consultation, earliest-form victory or new source interpretation is claimed.

independent_validation.mobile_boundary: Mobile export carries text and notes but omits source/review metadata by design; source equality was verified in YAML, not claimed as mobile source transport.

application_condition: Only the exact bound candidate is approved substantively for the specified local note/metadata application. A separately independently reviewed fail-closed guarded transaction, current-input preflight, recorded intent and actual post-application verification remain required. This judgment is not an executor approval and does not itself apply anything.
